title: LiveVoiceParams
description: VibeVoice-Realtime 0.5B voice preset. file_stem matches <lang>-<Name>_<gender>.pt (en-Carter_man, de-Spk0_man). preset_kind kv_cache is the serialized prefilled prompt, not a reference WAV. single_speaker is required. experimental is true for the optional multilingual presets (de, fr, it, jp, kr, nl, pl, pt, sp). The published realtime card is English-first; other languages are the experimental presets.
